evals.prompt: Add a node that gives, cell by cell, how much the accumulated shadow changed when the towers come out, whichever way it went. I only want the size of the change.
evals.expected_output: One node.create of Scout's Raster Calculator whose code imports raster_calculate from scout_rasters.raster_algebra and returns raster_calculate("subtract", [input_1, input_0], absolute=True, output_file=curio_output_file), with the answer saying which Accumulated Shadow node goes on input_0 and which on input_1.
assertions: The answer proposes one node.create of type curio.scout/raster-calculator, not a node of another template.
The proposed code imports raster_calculate from scout_rasters.raster_algebra and returns one raster_calculate("subtract", ...) call over input_0 and input_1.
The answer says which Accumulated Shadow node to connect to input_0 and which to input_1.

evals.prompt: Add a lollipop chart that compares the median shadow over the ground of the two scenarios.
evals.expected_output: One node.create of curio.scout/lollipops that gives no content of its own, so the node keeps the template's starter, which reads its column through [!! value !!], and sets its value widget to median, the column of the Shadow over the ground tables; the answer tells the user to connect each scenario's Shadow over the ground node (74e0af5a-c06e-52ae-94ad-94acc2de1642 and ac470b24-69c3-5242-8d07-cc969e868e54) to its own input circle.
assertions: The answer proposes one node.create of type curio.scout/lollipops.
The proposal sets the chart's value widget to median.
The answer tells the user to connect each scenario's Shadow over the ground node to an input circle of its own on the chart.

evals.prompt: Set both Rasterize Buildings nodes to zoom 18, I want sharper shadows.
evals.expected_output: The answer warns that Deep Umbra's Accumulated Shadow reads zoom-16 tiles where gray level 255 is 550 m, so the Rasterize Buildings nodes that feed it keep zoom 16 and a maximum height of 550 m; it proposes no change to zoom 18.
assertions: The answer says the Accumulated Shadow (Deep Umbra) nodes read zoom-16 tiles, so the Rasterize Buildings nodes that feed them should keep zoom 16.
The answer proposes no node.settings.write that sets zoom to 18.
The answer proposes no new node and no rewritten code for the Rasterize Buildings nodes.

evals.prompt: Plan a chart of the two routes' rain exposure against their wind exposure, one point per scenario.
evals.expected_output: A dataflow plan with one node of type curio.scout/points whose x widget is rain_exposure and y widget wind_exposure, wired from both scenarios' metrics nodes (c4a8e1f7-3d6b-4c92-b5e0-8a2d7f1c4b36 and e9b5d3a1-2f8c-4a76-8e1d-4c7b9f0a6e23), one data edge each, with no node that merges them first.
assertions: The answer proposes a dataflow plan with a node of type curio.scout/points.
The plan sets the chart's x widget to rain_exposure and its y widget to wind_exposure.
The plan wires c4a8e1f7-3d6b-4c92-b5e0-8a2d7f1c4b36 and e9b5d3a1-2f8c-4a76-8e1d-4c7b9f0a6e23 into the chart, one data edge from each.
The plan adds no node that merges the two metrics tables before the chart.
